import json, os, glob
p='inputs/manifest.json'
print('manifest exists', os.path.exists(p))
mf=json.load(open(p))
print(json.dumps(mf)[:1500])
files=[]
for root,d,fs in os.walk('inputs'):
    for f in fs:
        files.append(os.path.join(root,f))
print(files[:20])
import openpyxl
path=[f for f in files if f.lower().endswith('.xlsx')]
print(path)
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(path[0], data_only=True)
for ws in wb.worksheets:
    print('SHEET', ws.title, ws.max_row, ws.max_column)
    for r in range(1, min(5, ws.max_row)+1):
        vals=[(c.coordinate, repr(c.value), c.data_type) for c in ws[r]]
        print(vals)
    # last rows
    for r in range(max(1,ws.max_row-2), ws.max_row+1):
        print('tail',[(c.coordinate, repr(c.value), c.data_type) for c in ws[r]])
    # distinct types per column
    from collections import Counter
    for col in range(1, ws.max_column+1):
        cnt=Counter()
        for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1):
            c=ws.cell(row=r,column=col)
            cnt[(c.data_type, type(c.value).__name__)]+=1
        print('col', col, ws.cell(row=1,column=col).value, dict(cnt))
